api_link.identity: Btrieve API Set Interface DLL v6.20
api_link.finding: BTRCALL marshals the seven caller arguments plus an internal client block; it selects a connected engine/session transport and does not itself contain the physical page-write engine.

proven_findings: The physical disk and durability boundary lies below WBTRV32.DLL in W32MKDE.EXE or an equivalent BMKDE server reached through the named-pipe/session transport.
W32MKDE.EXE directly imports FlushFileBuffers, WriteFile, SetFilePointer, LockFile, UnlockFile, MoveFileA, DeleteFileA, and SetEndOfFile.
W32MKDE.EXE contains explicit transaction-log, recovery-log, cache, background, coordinator, and recovery implementation domains.
The supplied installation contains the local MKDE engine required by WBTRV32's AUTOSTART path.
